title: Jitra Half Marathon 2026 Review: A Return to Kedah's WWII Frontline Town
seo_title: Jitra Half Marathon 2026 Review | Kedah, Malaysia
meta_description: Jitra Half Marathon 2026 review: September 19 at Darulaman Park -- a returning race in Kedah's fourth-largest town, developer-backed with tiered pricing.
dek: Set for 19 September 2026 at Darulaman Park in Jitra, Kedah, this developer-backed race markets itself as returning for another September edition -- three distances with early-bird pricing tiers running through July.
verdict: The Jitra Half Marathon is organised by BDB Leisure, part of the Bina Darulaman Berhad property group, and its own marketing explicitly frames the 2026 edition as the race 'returning' in September -- implying at least one prior edition, though specific past-year details weren't found in research. Three distances (21K/10K/5K) with tiered early-bird pricing (RM50-95 depending on distance and registration window) keep it accessible. Jitra itself is Kedah's fourth-largest town and a site of real historical significance -- one of the fiercest battles of the WWII Malayan campaign was fought there in 1941 -- giving the race a backdrop with more depth than its modest scale might suggest.

sections.heading: A Developer-Backed Race Returning to Jitra
paragraphs: The race is organised by BDB Leisure Sdn. Bhd., part of the Bina Darulaman Berhad property group, and its official marketing explicitly bills the 2026 edition as the Jitra Half Marathon 'returning' ('kembali') in September. [1] That phrasing implies a prior edition, though specific details from earlier years weren't found in available research -- worth treating as a race with some history rather than a pure debut.

sections.heading: Three Distances, Tiered Pricing
paragraphs: Distances offered are 21.1K, 10K and 5K, starting at Darulaman Park in Jitra. [1] Pricing runs RM80/65/50 for the 21km/10km/5km respectively during the Early Bird period (through 31 May 2026), rising to RM95/85/65 for registrations between 1 June and 31 July 2026 -- a straightforward tiered structure that rewards early sign-up.

sections.heading: Jitra: Kedah's Fourth-Largest Town, WWII History
paragraphs: Jitra is the seat of Kubang Pasu District in northern Kedah, the fourth-largest town in the state after Alor Setar, Sungai Petani and Kulim, with a 2020 population of just under 95,000. [2] It carries genuine historical weight: during World War II, when Japan invaded Malaya, Jitra sat on one of the main British defence lines, and one of the fiercest battles of the entire Malayan campaign was fought there in December 1941.

sections.heading: A Purpose-Built Park Venue
paragraphs: Darulaman Park sits within Bandar Darulaman, a planned township development associated with the same Bina Darulaman Berhad group organising the race -- giving the event a venue built with road infrastructure and green space specifically in mind, rather than an improvised city-street course.

sections.heading: Should You Run It?
paragraphs: If a straightforward, reasonably priced half marathon in a historically significant northern Malaysian town appeals, and you register early to lock in the lower pricing tier, the Jitra Half Marathon on 19 September 2026 is a solid regional pick. It's a smaller-scale event than the big-city races in this batch, but the developer backing and returning-event framing suggest more operational continuity than a first-year debut.
